name: C2C Advanced Systems Ltd
tagline: Niche naval/defence C4ISR software with an SME listing -- but a BDO India forensic review, a going-concern-qualified FY26 audit and a books-cooking history make this an AVOID
business_overview: C2C Advanced Systems builds vertically integrated defence electronics/software -- combat management systems (CMS), decision support systems, C4ISR (MAGI-C4ISR platform), radar/EW/sonar sub-systems -- for naval, army, air and space platforms, plus dual-use Industry 4.0 offerings. Listed on the NSE SME platform. It has an MoU with Adani Defence and orders/POs from the Royal Malaysian Navy and a Canadian naval programme.
fundamentals_table: ~13.5% / ~8.5% -- weak, and of questionable reliability given the review findings
H1 FY26 revenue ~Rs 66-68 Cr (+56% YoY), H1 PAT ~Rs 24 Cr (+143% YoY) -- then H2 FY26 swung to a loss
Combined CFO of about -Rs 157 Cr over 5 years vs reported profits
~349 debtor days, working capital ~524 days; ~78% of sales outstanding at one balance-sheet date
fundamentals_narrative: Headline growth looks explosive but is not supported by cash: five-year cumulative operating cash flow is deeply negative while the P&L shows rising profits, and receivables/working-capital days are at the extreme end even for defence. The FY26 full-year picture is worse -- a ~50-day-delayed result, a loss, and a geographic revenue pattern that inverted between halves (domestic ~Rs 66 Cr H1 vs ~Rs 4 Cr H2; USA ~Rs 0 H1 vs ~Rs 76 Cr H2).
technical_read: Not pulled -- stock has fallen ~70-90% from its post-listing high and has hit repeated lower circuits on governance news; price action is not investable here.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 posts (#34-88) of an 88-post thread, Jan 2025 to Aug 2026. The thread turned decisively negative in Feb 2025 when an NSE-pushed BDO India LLP review report documented RHP-vs-books mismatches in related-party disclosures, sales concentration of ~74% to related/connected customers (two undisclosed as related parties), and minimal collections. Members (BuyRightSitTight, Dhvanit_Merchant17, Nabendu, randomquarks, MHS) repeatedly frame it as a case to stay away from and compare it to Gensol. A monitoring-agency report (Oct 2025) reiterated the same issues. In Jul 2026 the auditor issued a going-concern uncertainty and a qualified opinion alongside a loss. Management (concall, Jul 2026) disputes the going-concern reading and says no SEBI matter is pending, but has a documented history of restated/erroneous disclosures.
community_signal: No credible high-conviction buy call from a roster user. Nikunj_Todi (trusted, elevated) posted neutral concall notes on receivable-recovery guidance -- a distressed-situation update, not an endorsement.

trusted_signals.note: Concall notes: new CEO guiding receivable/balance-sheet clean-up by Sept 2026, 80% of >180-day receivables to be collected, EPF dues cleared, quarterly reporting from Mar 2027. Informational; does not address the forensic-review findings.

bse_notes: NSE-published BDO India LLP review report (Feb 2025) and a subsequent monitoring-agency report (Oct 2025) both flag related-party and revenue-recognition issues. FY26 audit carries a going-concern uncertainty and a qualified opinion. Prior CFO resignation. Preferential/warrant issue subsequently cleared by NSE.
bull_case: Genuinely niche naval C4ISR/CMS software IP with few Indian peers, and some real POs (Royal Malaysian Navy, a Canadian naval programme)
MoU with Adani Defence for drone/anti-drone and command-and-control software
New CEO has given specific, dated receivable-collection guidance
bear_case: Independent forensic review documents books-cooking: RHP-vs-books mismatches, ~74% sales to related/connected parties, undisclosed related parties, negligible collections
FY26 audit qualified with a going-concern uncertainty; full-year swung to a loss with an implausible half-on-half revenue geography inversion
~Rs 157 Cr cumulative negative operating cash flow over 5 years against reported profits; ~349 debtor days
History of erroneous disclosures and a prior CFO exit; repeated lower circuits on governance news
verdict_headline: AVOID -- going-concern-qualified audit plus a documented forensic-review history of cooked books
verdict_reasoning: Red-flag tier AVOID: the FY26 statutory audit carries a going-concern material uncertainty and a qualified opinion, and an NSE-pushed BDO India review independently documented revenue-recognition and related-party manipulation -- this overrides any thesis consideration
The reported hyper-growth is contradicted by ~5 years of deeply negative operating cash flow and extreme receivable days; the numbers cannot be relied upon
First-time research pass; no roster user has made a high-conviction buy call -- the only trusted post is a neutral concall summary

thesis_fit neither, conviction Low; not a candidate under any circumstances until a clean, unqualified audit and demonstrated cash collection appear -- and even then the promoter track record is a lasting overhang
red_flag_reason: FY26 audit issued with a going-concern material uncertainty and a qualified opinion; independent forensic review (BDO India LLP, published by NSE) documented RHP-vs-books mismatches, related-party revenue concentration and undisclosed related parties; ~5-year cumulative operating cash flow about -Rs 157 Cr against reported profits.
